ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the substrate is an R-substituted carbamic acid/carbamate-like structure, and the skeleton can be read as R-NH-C(=O)-OH: the N on the left is connected to R, H, and the carbonyl carbon; the middle carbon already has one C=O; the right side is C-O-H; beside it there is a base :B, and curved arrows are drawn to indicate electron transfer. The arrows in the figure indicate that the base takes the proton on O-H, while O-H/C-O related electron rearrangement makes the carboxyl carbon form a second C=O, and the N-C bond electrons return to nitrogen and break. Reasoning: After pushing according to the arrows, the N-C bond breaks, and the R-substituted amine fragment separates from the carboxyl carbon; the carboxyl carbon simultaneously becomes O=C=O, that is, carbon dioxide. Therefore the product state is two unconnected molecules: R-amine and CO2. Using the wildcard R group, the R-amine is represented as [*]N, carbon dioxide as O=C=O, separated by a dot in between.

method.method_draft: Inspect the image first: identify the carbamic-acid-like molecule R-NH-C(=O)-OH and follow each curved arrow. Apply the arrows to cleave the N-C bond and form the second carbonyl on the carboxyl carbon, yielding two disconnected products: the R-substituted amine and CO2. Encode these as [*]N and O=C=O separated by a dot, giving [*]N.O=C=O.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中底物是一个 R 取代的氨基甲酸/氨基甲酸酯样结构，骨架可读作 R-NH-C(=O)-OH：左侧 N 与 R、H 和羰基碳相连；中间碳已有一个 C=O；右侧是 C-O-H；旁边有碱 :B，并画有弯箭头表示电子转移。图中箭头表示碱夺取 O-H 上的质子，同时 O-H/C-O 相关电子重排使羧基碳形成第二个 C=O，且 N-C 键电子回到氮上而断裂。推理：按箭头推动后，N-C 键断开，R 取代的胺片段与羧基碳分离；羧基碳同时成为 O=C=O，即二氧化碳。因此产物状态为两个不相连分子：R-胺和 CO2。用通配 R 基团表示 R-胺为 [*]N，二氧化碳为 O=C=O，中间用点分隔。
